characters.bio: Still here. There is some give.

location.name: Coastal sage scrub on Point Loma, San Diego

episode.subject: Cucamonga manroot
episode.title: Still attached
episode.body:
I caught the little twig and wound the stretch between us into a spring.

The first gust pulled us away from each other. I thought I was losing her.

The coil lengthened. My tip stayed wrapped around the twig.

proposals.visualReview: Coiled green tendril and its attachment to a small woody neighbor are visible. Source identifies Marah macrocarpa gripping lemonade berry. Static image does not show the gust or prove a measured length change; those are fictional motion grounded in the pictured coil and its supporting function. Opposite coil handedness was considered but not asserted.
